sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 180.
-Target: all enemies. Healing Ability Power 100. Heals HP. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
